name: page-review
description: A local-first Chrome extension for annotating rendered web pages and exporting implementation-ready feedback.
author: Rex Kirshner

scripts.test:channels: npm run build:dev && npm run build:release && tsx --test tests/channels.test.ts
scripts.test:extension: npm run build:dev && npm run build:release && playwright test tests/extension/*.test.ts --workers=1
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:channels && npm run test:extension && npm run test:store && npm run test:release
